message: Exact BF16 TP2 startup with the official checkpoint chat_template.jinja and --tokenizer-mode hf failed in vLLM 0.26.0 before serving: ValueError: Failed to apply PixtralProcessor on the dummy image input. The same-family native Mistral tokenizer path previously rejected custom chat templates for Ministral-3-8B. No prompt, parser, or protocol changes and no treatment trials were attempted.
